{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Listing Dewback''''' was a light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned by [[Shella Rinou]]. The ship was equipped with [[sensor/Legends|sensor]] jamming systems and several stealth programs, which facilitated her illegal trips to defended planets such as [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref>In According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and the ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', the events of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'']] multimedia project take place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> the ship journeyed to Rodia to deliver a cargo of weapons to a [[Unidentified smuggling client|client]]; it necessitated a backup stealth program to pass through the upgraded sensor net. The ship landed for a first time on an impromptu landmg pad among the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[planet/Legends|planet]].
